title: A worker session serves its head on its own port, and a product review still serves on the declared address
description: A fixture worker session runs graphyard.json's e2e serve command with its launch environment: it answers on the session's GRAPHYARD_E2E_SERVE_PORT, never 4391. While it serves, a product review of another item serves its head on the declared address with no 'already answers before the serve command starts' failure.

steps.name: the worker's serve and the review's serve run side by side
